one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud provides headless ecommerce APIs, sandboxes, and development tools.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with JWT tokens via Salesforce Account Manager and SLAS.
access_notes: Requires purchasing sandbox credits, setting up user roles, and configuring an API client via Account Manager or Account Executive.
api_notes: Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) covers catalogs, products, shoppers, orders, and more.
blocker_notes: Requires sandbox credits and contract interaction with an Account Executive to get working credentials.

reasons.auth: Public docs reference OAuth2 client‑credentials flow via API client ID and password, and JWT (SLAS) for Shopper APIs.
reasons.access: To obtain credentials, an administrator must create an API client ID in Account Manager; this requires approval or review before a developer can use the Sandbox API.
reasons.mcp: No official MCP server is documented by Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
reasons.verdict: The API is publicly documented and accessible, but a developer must go through an admin approval step to get working credentials, so building today requires that friction.
